course.title: Massage Therapy
course.tagline: Learn safe, relaxing massage techniques for the back, neck and full body.

days.title: Welcome to Massage Therapy
days.goal: By the end of today you can explain and practise: Your kit is massage oil, towels, a table or mat, and clean sheets.

steps: Get your tools ready: massage oil, clean towels and massage table.
Watch the video. It explains the main point in simple steps: Massage oil reduces friction so strokes glide smoothly.
Your kit is massage oil, towels, a table or mat, and clean sheets. Go slowly. Practise on a model or a practice head.
Do the same move three times. Check your work in a mirror or a photo after each try.
Write down what went well, what was hard, and one thing to do better tomorrow.
